adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at lines 92-108, the code first does `await prisma.booking.update(...)` to add attendees to the database, then later calls `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` to sync with the calendar. If the calendar sync fails, the database already has the new attendees committed, but the user gets an error. On retry, the guests would be filtered out by the `uniqueGuests` check (lines 72-76) since they're already in `booking.attendees`, resulting in 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' error with no way to complete the calendar sync. This is a legitimate transactional consistency bug.
